title: 339章 平阳喋血，汉蛮倒置
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

平阳桥外的旷野之上，漫天硝烟早已被烈风撕碎，混着尘土与血沫肆意翻卷。明军大阵列于北坡，层层盾墙林立如壁，与南麓步步压来的后金大军遥遥对峙。

后金阵前，数十辆丈余高的榆木盾车缓缓前移，厚重车身外裹浸油厚毡，边缘钉满防滑铁齿。车后隐伏数百汉军弓手，两蓝旗巴牙喇精锐藏匿于车架缝隙，蓄势待发。随着督战的白甲喇厉声喝令，盾车后的弓手齐齐弯弓搭箭，沉甸甸的重箭破风呼啸，黑压压砸向明军阵线。

“咻——咻——”

箭雨如云垂落，明军士卒所披布面甲在后金重箭面前形同虚设。锋利箭镞轻易撕裂甲片、洞穿骨肉，阵中惨叫接连响起，士兵纷纷应声栽倒。鲜血顺着箭杆浸透荒草，转瞬便被往来脚步踏作泥泞。更致命的是数十步外的精准狙杀，数名巴牙喇伏于盾车死角，挽弓冷射，铅芯重箭专挑要害，明军弓手接连被钉死在地，场面触目惊心。

明军亦奋力还击。佛郎机炮车排布阵中，炮口赤火喷涌，铁弹轰然砸向盾车。不少车轮轴木应声断裂，盾车歪斜倾覆，推车的汉军士卒遭铁弹贯穿，尸身堆叠车下，沦为阻碍后队推进的障碍。更有盾车经不起连环轰击，木架炸裂崩碎，尖锐木刺四下飞溅，藏于后方的后金兵满身血洞，哀嚎翻滚。

阵前三眼铳、单兵火铳连环轰鸣，铅弹砸在厚木毡盾之上尽数弹落，只扬起漫天木屑尘土。寻常火器难以破防后金重甲，唯有近距离贴身轰击方能致命。反倒是明军小梢弓阵尽显奇效，此弓拉力八斗，穿甲不及后金硬弓，却胜在射速迅猛。后金一箭之隙，明军已然两发齐出，箭蝗漫天，专射无甲与薄棉甲的汉军辅兵，杀伤极盛。

噗嗤利刃入肉之声不绝，汉军士卒成片倒地，不少盾车因推车人手尽亡而停滞不前。若非巴牙喇督战队挥刀斩杀逃兵，前线汉军早已四散奔逃。

鞭笞与严令之下，盾车再度强行推进。三十步、二十步，两军距离急速拉近，短兵相接已是迫在眉睫。

“杀！”

一声狂暴嘶吼响起，盾车后的汉军兵卒举盾持枪，猛然窜出掩体，嘶吼着亡命扑向明军防线。

刘渠立于中军麾盖之下，早已看破后金歹毒算计，厉声传令：“前阵三眼铳，全军齐射！”

前排士卒即刻点燃引信，灼热火药引燃铳膛，连绵巨响骤然炸开。

“嘭——嘭——嘭！”

震耳欲聋的铳声撼动四野，密集铅弹如暴雨泼洒，直面冲锋的汉军瞬间成片倒地。近距离之下，无甲辅兵无从抵挡，纵使身披双层重甲的精锐，遭铅弹重击亦是骨碎筋断、非死即残。一轮齐射，近千汉军折损阵前，层层尸骸堆砌成一道血色矮墙。

短暂的僵持转瞬破碎。盾车缝隙骤然暴起杀机，正蓝、镶蓝旗巴牙喇精锐尽数杀出。人人身披两至三层精铁重甲，肩扛虎枪、手挥斩马长刀，如同饿虎扑羊，蛮横撞入明军前阵。寒铁刀锋劈落之间血雾弥漫，明军寻常刀枪劈刺在重甲之上难破分毫，转瞬便被拦腰斩断、身首异处。

“鞑子诡计阴毒！”

刘渠面色骤变，心头骤然彻悟。后金刻意以汉军为前驱，意在耗尽明军火器弹药，待三眼铳火力枯竭，再遣重甲精锐强行破阵，步步算计，歹毒至极。

危局临头，刘渠神色沉稳，声透硝烟厉声喝令：“李茂春、张明先！领本部骑兵，即刻反向冲阵！”

两名游击拱手领命，率领千余精锐骑兵疾驰而出。人马落地步战，人手一柄三眼铳，对准突阵的巴牙喇齐齐开火。铅弹循着甲胄缝隙钻刺而入，逼得后金精锐攻势骤然一滞。转瞬之间，士卒反手紧握铳身，将十斤重的生铁铳器当作重锤，狠狠砸向敌兵头颅。

“铛！”

金铁交鸣巨响刺耳，数名巴牙喇铁盔凹陷碎裂，红白脑浆顺着面甲缓缓流淌；另有长刀被生生砸弯，后金兵当即抽出腰间骨朵，奋力反击猛砸。两蓝旗的猛攻硬生生被强行遏止，冲锋阵形一时大乱。

刘渠刚稳住中路防线，余光骤然扫过左翼——孙得功所部驻防之地，竟全无半点驰援动静，死寂一片。

下一刻，一枚赤红火箭刺破苍穹，扶摇升空。

大地隆隆震颤，左翼外侧密林尘土翻涌如浪。皇太极统领的两白旗铁骑尽数杀出，马蹄踏碎荒草冻土，重甲铁骑寒光凛冽，长枪如林森然排布，震天喊杀裹挟杀伐之气，直扑孙得功防区。

刘渠远远眺望，孙得功麾下兵马过万，阵列完整、防御森严。他心中稍稍安定，料定此部纵使挡不住铁骑猛攻，也足以拖延时日，待中军援兵赶到，便可合围反击、稳住战局。

谁料惊天异变陡然爆发！

两白旗铁骑距防线仅剩三百步时，左翼明军非但未放炮御敌、挽弓死守，反倒阵脚大乱、人心惶惶。只见孙得功率领千余亲信家丁骤然调转马头，头也不回朝着广宁城狂奔逃窜，边跑边嘶声狂喊：

“败了！鞑子破阵了！全军快逃！”

为彻底搅乱军心，这群叛卒竟挥刀砍杀身旁不明真相的同袍，更行歹毒之举，以巨斧劈断左翼象征军令的中军大纛。

“噗通——”

猩红战旗轰然坠地，旗面拖拽过泥泞血土，彻底击碎了左翼明军最后的军心。

“两白旗杀过来了！”

Page (1/3)

In the wilderness outside Pingyang Bridge, the sky full of gunpowder smoke had already been torn apart by the strong wind, and was mixed with dust and blood foam and rolled wantonly.The Ming army formed a large array on the north slope, with layers of shield walls standing like walls, facing off from a distance with the Hou Jin army pressing forward step by step from the south.

In front of the Houjin Formation, dozens of elm shield cars more than ten feet high moved forward slowly. The heavy body was wrapped in oil-impregnated thick felt, and the edges were studded with anti-skid iron teeth.Hundreds of Han army archers lurked behind the vehicle, and two elite Baja soldiers of the Blue Banner were hidden in the gaps between the vehicle's frames, ready to attack.Following the stern orders from Bai Jia La, who was supervising the battle, the archers behind the shield chariot bent their bows and set arrows. The heavy arrows whistled through the wind and hit the Ming army's line with a black pressure.

"Whoosh-whoosh-"

Arrows rained down like clouds, and the cloth masks worn by the soldiers of the Ming Dynasty were useless in front of the heavy arrows of Hou Jin.The sharp arrowheads easily tore through armor and penetrated flesh and bones. Screams rang out one after another in the formation, and the soldiers fell down one after another.The blood soaked into the grass along the arrow shaft, and in an instant it was turned into mud by the footsteps.What was even more deadly was the precise sniper kill from dozens of steps away. Several Bajara lurked in the blind corner of the shield chariot, drew their bows and fired coldly, using lead-core heavy arrows to target key points. Ming army archers were nailed to the ground one after another. The scene was shocking.

The Ming army also fought back vigorously.The Folang machine gun carriages were arranged in formation, red fire spewed out from the muzzles, and iron bullets crashed into the shield carriages.Many wheels and axles broke, the shield cart tilted and overturned, the Han soldiers pushing the cart were pierced by iron bullets, and their bodies were stacked under the cart, becoming an obstacle to the advancement of the rear troops.Moreover, the shield car could not withstand the continuous bombardment. The wooden frame exploded and shattered, and the sharp wooden thorns flew everywhere. The Houjin soldiers hiding behind were covered with blood holes, wailing and rolling.

In front of the formation, three-eyed muskets and individual fire muskets roared continuously, and the lead bullets hit the thick wooden felt shield and all bounced off, leaving only sawdust and dust in the sky.It is difficult for ordinary firearms to break through the defense of Houjin's heavy armor, and only close-range and personal bombardment can be fatal.On the contrary, the small shoot bow formation of the Ming army showed miraculous effects. This bow had eight draws and could not penetrate armor as well as the rear golden bow, but it was better than the fast and fierce shooting speed.In the gap between Hou Jin's arrows, the Ming army had already launched two rounds of arrows, and the sky was filled with arrows, specifically shooting at the Han army's auxiliary soldiers without armor and thin cotton armor, causing great damage.

There was an endless sound of the sharp blade piercing flesh, and the Han soldiers fell to the ground in pieces. Many shield carts were stagnant because all the men pushing the carts were dead.If it hadn't been for Baya Ladu's team to kill the deserters with their swords, the Han troops on the front line would have fled in all directions.

Under whippings and strict orders, the shield car pushed forward forcefully again.Thirty steps, twenty steps, the distance between the two armies quickly narrowed, and a hand-to-hand encounter was imminent.

"Kill!"

A violent roar rang out, and the Han soldiers behind the shield cart raised their shields and guns, suddenly rushed out of the bunker, roared and rushed towards the Ming army's defense line.

Liu Qu stood under the command of the Chinese army. He had already seen through Hou Jin's vicious plan and sternly issued an order: "Three-eyed muskets in the front line, the whole army fires in volley!"

The soldiers in the front row immediately lit the fuse, and the hot gunpowder ignited the barrel of the gun, which suddenly exploded with a loud bang.

"Bang-bang-bang!"

The deafening sound of gunfire shook the surrounding areas, and dense lead bullets poured down like a torrential rain. The Han troops facing the charge fell to the ground in an instant.At close range, the unarmored auxiliary soldiers had no way to resist. Even the elites wearing double-layered heavy armor would suffer severe injuries from broken bones and muscles, and would be killed or maimed by lead bullets.After a round of volleys, nearly a thousand Han troops were destroyed in front of the formation, and layers of corpses were piled up to form a bloody low wall.

The brief stalemate was shattered in an instant.The gap in the shield car suddenly erupted with murderous intent, and all the elites of Zhenglan and Xianglan Banner fought out.Wearing two to three layers of heavy iron armor, carrying tiger spears on their shoulders, and wielding long horse-killing knives in their hands, they were like hungry tigers attacking sheep, and they barged into the front line of the Ming army.The blood mist filled the air when the cold iron blade fell. The Ming army's ordinary swords and spears could hardly break through the heavy armor. In an instant, they were cut off at the waist and their heads were missing.

"The Tatars are scheming and sinister!"

Liu Qu's expression suddenly changed, and he suddenly realized something in his heart.Hou Jin deliberately used the Han army as the vanguard, intending to use up the Ming army's firearms and ammunition. When the three-eyed gunfire was exhausted, he would send heavily armored elites to forcefully break the formation, calculating every step and being extremely vicious.

When the crisis was imminent, Liu Qu looked calm and shouted sharply through the smoke: "Li Maochun, Zhang Mingxian! Lead the cavalry of our headquarters and charge in the opposite direction immediately!"

The two guerrillas accepted the order and led more than a thousand elite cavalry to gallop out.The men and horses fell to the ground and fought on foot. Each man held a three-eyed blunderbuss and fired at the Ba Ya La who broke out of the formation.The lead bullets penetrated through the gaps in the armor, forcing Houjin's elite offensive to suddenly stall.In the blink of an eye, the soldier grasped the gun body tightly with his backhand, used the ten-pound pig iron gun as a heavy hammer, and smashed the enemy's head hard.

"Cang!"

There was a loud and ear-piercing sound of gold and iron, and several Bajala's iron helmets were dented and shattered, with red and white brains flowing slowly along the face armor; some long knives were bent and bent, and the rear Jin soldiers immediately pulled out the bones from their waists and fought back with all their strength.The fierce attack of the two blue flags was forcibly stopped, and the charging formation was temporarily in chaos.

Liu Qu had just stabilized the middle line of defense when his peripheral vision suddenly swept across the left wing - the place where Sun Degong's troops were stationed. There was no sign of reinforcements at all, and it was completely silent.

The next moment, a red rocket pierced the sky and soared into the sky.

The earth rumbled and trembled, and the dust in the dense forest outside the left wing billowed like waves.The two white-flag cavalry led by Huang Taiji all rushed out, their horse hooves trampled the grass and frozen soil, the heavy-armored cavalry's cold light was cold, their spears were arranged like a forest, and they rushed towards Sun Degong's defense area with loud shouts of killing and a murderous spirit.

Liu Qu looked from afar and saw that Sun Degong had over 10,000 soldiers and horses, with complete formations and tight defenses.He felt a little more at ease, thinking that even if this unit could not stop the fierce cavalry attack, it would be enough to delay the attack. When the Chinese reinforcements arrived, they could encircle and counterattack and stabilize the battle situation.

Unexpectedly, a shocking change suddenly broke out!

When the two white flag cavalry were only 300 steps away from the defense line, the left-wing Ming army not only did not fire artillery to defend the enemy, but held their bows tightly. Instead, their positions were in chaos and people were panicked.I saw Sun Degong leading more than a thousand of his trusted servants to suddenly turn their horses and run away towards Guangning City without looking back, shouting wildly as they ran:

"Defeated! The Tatars have broken the formation! The whole army is running away!"

In order to completely disrupt the morale of the army, this group of rebel soldiers actually wielded knives to kill their comrades who did not know the truth. They even carried out a vicious move and used giant axes to chop off the large banner of the Chinese army on the left wing that symbolized military orders.

"Plop——"

The scarlet battle flag crashed to the ground, dragging the flag through the mud and blood, completely shattering the last remaining morale of the left-wing Ming army.

"Two white flags are coming!"
